name: Season
overview: Scripture reveals that God has established distinct seasons and times as part of His orderly creation, marked by lights in the heavens to separate day from night and to signal seasons, days, and years (Genesis 1:14). These seasons—seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter—are enduring and purposeful, continuing as long as the earth remains (Genesis 8:22). Ecclesiastes emphasizes that every event and purpose has its appointed season under heaven, highlighting God's sovereign timing (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Believers are encouraged to persevere in good works, trusting that in due season they will reap the fruit of their labor (Galatians 6:9).
